title: Admissibility and change of variables for the dilated pair (λ^{−m}η_*μ, ξ(a + λ·))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P (Euclid P) and λ > 0, and let η := dilation a λ, η(y) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y = λ⁻¹(y − a). Let μ be a measure on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra) with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P. Let ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P m, the continuous linear functionals on m-covectors) be μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| (|α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α) for μ-a.e. x and every m-covector α. Put μ₂ := ofReal(λ^{−m})·η_*μ (Lean: ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ) and ξ₂(y) := ξ(a + λy). Then: (a) μ₂(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P; (b) ξ₂ is μ₂-a.e. strongly measurable; (c) for μ₂-a.e. y, |ξ(a + λy)(α)| ≤ |α| for every m-covector α; (d) for every set S ⊆ ℝ^P and every map ω : ℝ^P → Λ^m(ℝ^P) (a DifferentialForm; no regularity assumed), ∫_S ξ(a + λy)(ω(y)) dμ₂(y) = λ^{−m}·∫_{η⁻¹(S)} ξ(x)(ω(η(x))) dμ(x) (Bochner integrals).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), 0 < lam → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ) K < ∞) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => ξ (a + lam • y)) (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ) ∧ (∀ᵐ y ∂(ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, |ξ (a + lam • y) α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∀ (S : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m), ∫ y in S, ξ (a + lam • y) (ω y) ∂(ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ) = lam⁻¹ ^ m * ∫ x in dilation a lam ⁻¹' S, ξ x (ω (dilation a lam x)) ∂μ
